### 2026-10-13 – I wasn't very happy with the rough mould I & "shape" trew together last time but rather than fix it I tried to improve the form  concepts to make it a bit better - tolerances and weep holes along with

**2h**

I wasn't very happy with the rough mould I & "shape" trew together last time but rather than fix it I tried to improve the form  concepts to make it a bit better - tolerances and weep holes along with guides to limit the compression to a desirable depth

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 at 22.38.11](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/afB45WLTnSAsFqrMq92IoTER2dLA2UXI/3e08a7456e9ff1858abd9e2dfde9093e199145384925afc11ec8ed74985b92ed.png)

Then I made the github for this project and did some further more scientific research to find a few  science backed papers into the process and even stumbled across a way I  might be able to strengthen my final products with some CHEMISTRY!!! over the rest of the week I hope to mainly make a good mould even if it not the most complex shape and to create some test recipes based on the research I  have done so far.
